_comment: Source of truth for the CAC web family. Copied byte-for-byte into each site repo (cacnorthamerica, cac-salvation-center, yyam). Edit it in ONE place, copy it everywhere, then run: node scripts/check-network.mjs <path to another copy>. Only facts already stated on the sites belong here; use null where a fact is not confirmed yet.
